mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential demand, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a robust labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a supply shock, reducing corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) typically triggers central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and depressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1400 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, reducing consumer wealth and demand, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate monetary tightening and weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS declining and FEDFUNDS rising fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.
